mapper.insert: insert into metrics_snapshot (metric_key, window_start, window_end, source, numerator, denominator, value, threshold_version, status, sampled_at) values (#{metricKey}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{source}, #{numerator}, #{denominator}, #{value}, #{thresholdVersion}, #{status}, #{sampledAt}) on duplicate key update source = values(source), numerator = values(numerator), denominator = values(denominator), value = values(value), threshold_version = values(threshold_version), status = values(status), sampled_at = values(sampled_at)
mapper.select: select max(sampled_at) from metrics_snapshot where status = 'OK'
